page.title: asap – first the idea, then the date
page.description: asap – dating app: you like concrete date ideas instead of profiles.
page.pitchText: On asap you don't like faces, you like concrete plans. Whoever says yes already knows what you'll do – so you get to a real meeting faster.
page.pitch1: Ideas instead of profiles: brunch, canoe trip, jazz cellar – you still see the person.
page.pitch2: Like with a message: your request goes straight to the person behind the idea.
page.pitch3: From match to meeting: the date is already pinned in the chat – just pick a time.

0.title: Sunday brunch at Café Wacker, then a walk along the Main
0.description: Freshly roasted coffee, a long breakfast and then a stroll across the Eiserner Steg with a view of the skyline.

1.title: Bowling duel – loser buys the fries
1.description: Two rounds of bowling – whoever loses pays for the fries. Talent is explicitly not required.

2.title: Sunset picnic on the Lohrberg
2.description: Blanket, cheese, grapes and a bottle of apple wine spritzer – plus the best skyline view Frankfurt has to offer.

3.title: Paint & wine: we paint each other
3.description: Canvas, brushes, a glass of wine – and the task of painting each other. Laughs guaranteed, masterpiece less so.

4.title: Rowing on the Jacobiweiher
4.description: Row a lap, watch the ducks and find out which of us steers better. Waffles at the forest café afterwards?

5.title: Coffee tasting: three roasteries, one verdict
5.description: We test three roasteries and strictly grade crema, cake and atmosphere. The winner gets a second visit.

requests.receivedInfo: If you accept, it's a match and the idea becomes your planned date. If you decline, the person won't find out.
requests.noneText: As soon as someone wants to join one of your ideas, you'll see it here. Tip: the more concrete the idea, the more requests.
requests.sentInfo: Your likes go to the person behind the idea. Until they are accepted, they stay “open” here.
requests.noneSentText: Like ideas in the feed – your requests will show up here.

safety.subtitle: Safety
safety.blockHint: You won't see each other anymore – not even in the chat. The person won't be notified.
safety.blockText: Profile, ideas and your chat disappear for both of you. You can undo this in your profile under “Blocked people”.
safety.reportSub: Your report is confidential – {name} won't know who reported.
safety.reportHint: We review every report. If you are in immediate danger, please contact the police (110 in Germany).

blocked.title: Blocked people
blocked.info: Blocked people can't see your profile or ideas – and you can't see theirs. They don't know you blocked them.
blocked.noneText: If someone bothers you, you can block them via ⋯ in their profile or chat.
blocked.unblockText: You'll see each other again – an earlier chat will reappear too.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.deletePoint1: Your profile, ideas, likes, matches, chats and dates are deleted immediately.
privacy.deletePoint2: Your matches will no longer see your shared chat.
privacy.deletePoint3: Tip: download your data first if you want to keep it.
privacy.deletedText: Sorry to see you go. All the best!
